*The Shape of Water* (2017) is a romantic fantasy directed by Guillermo del Toro. Set in Baltimore in 1962, it follows Elisa, a mute janitor who works at a secret government laboratory. When the lab brings in a mysterious amphibious humanoid, Elisa begins visiting him in secret. She brings him hard-boiled eggs, plays him music, and communicates with him through sign language. Their friendship gradually turns into love.
When Elisa learns that the government plans to kill and dissect him, she enlists her friends to help him escape. The story is part Cold War thriller, part fairy tale about two outsiders who find a sense of belonging with each other.
